ei.title: Percentages of U.S. Teenagers Who Spent Time with Friends by Communication Type
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: The graph above shows the percentages of U.S. teenagers who spent time with friends by communication type, based on a survey conducted between 2014 and 2015. In the category of Every Day, text messaging showed the highest percentage among the four types of communication that teenagers used to spend time with friends. In the category of Less Often, the percentage of teenagers who spent time with friends through talking on the phone was more than twice that of teenagers who did so through text messaging. The percentage of teenagers who spent time with friends through talking on the phone in the category of Every Day was lower than that of teenagers who did so in the category of Less Often. In the category of Less Often, emailing was the second highest in percentage among the types of communication listed above. The percentage of teenagers who spent time with friends through video chatting in the category of Less Often was higher than that of teenagers who did so in the category of Every Day.

In the category of Less Often, the percentage of teenagers who spent time with friends through talking on the phone was more than twice that of teenagers who did so through text messaging. The percentage of teenagers who spent time with friends through talking on the phone in the category of Every Day was (C)[lower / higher] than that of teenagers who did so in the category of Less Often. The percentage of teenagers who spent time with friends through video chatting in the category of Less Often was higher than that of teenagers who did so in the category of Every Day.

❌ ③ lowest(가장 낮은)는 highest(가장 높은) 반의어
❌ ④ higher(더 높은)는 lower(더 낮은) 반의어

questions.passage: The graph above shows the percentages of U.S. teenagers who spent time with friends by communication type, based on a survey conducted between 2014 and 2015. In the category of Every Day, text messaging showed the highest percentage among the four types of communication that teenagers used to spend time with friends. In the category of Less Often, the percentage of teenagers who spent time with friends through talking on the phone was more than twice that of teenagers who did so through text messaging. The percentage of teenagers who spent time with friends through talking on the phone in the category of Every Day was lower than that of teenagers who did so in the category of Less Often. In the category of Less Often, emailing was __________ among the types of communication listed above. The percentage of teenagers who spent time with friends through video chatting in the category of Less Often was higher than that of teenagers who did so in the category of Every Day.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: '덜 자주' 범주에서, 이메일이 비율에서 두 번째로 높았다(the second highest in percentage)
det.analysis:
❌ ① the least popular in usage: 두 번째로 높은과 반대
❌ ② the most frequently mentioned: 비율 순위와 무관
❌ ③ the third lowest in ranking: 원문과 다른 순위
✅ ④ the second highest in percentage: 원문 일치 ← 정답
det.tip: the second highest in percentage = 비율에서 두 번째로 높은
